traits: Boon to ordinary delicate repairs outside combat
Boon when seeking mundane lodging through conversation
Boon to visually searching a distant scene
Ignore difficult terrain from natural undergrowth during voluntary movement
Boon to recalling events personally witnessed
Boon to balancing on a narrow stationary surface
Boon to balancing on loose stone
Boon to evaluating ordinary worked metal, not crafting permission
Boon to moving quietly outside combat
Boon to finding mundane shelter in inhabited countryside
Boon to locating a sound source
Boon to appearing harmless before hostile action

strike.name: Driving Strike
strike.text: One adjacent target; melee weapon. Physical 4/5/7. Strong may push 1 square. Instant; repeatable.

precise.name: Precise Strike
precise.text: One adjacent target; melee weapon. Physical 3/5/7. Strong may move self 1 square without provoking after damage. Instant; repeatable.

shot.name: Aimed Shot
shot.text: Visible target within 8; ranged weapon/ammunition. Physical 4/5/7. Strong reveals whether target has physical resistance, not its value. Inventory check per attack. Instant; repeatable.

fire.name: Fire Dart
fire.text: Visible target within 6. Fire 4/5/7. Strong ignites one unattended flammable object in target square if desired, not the creature. Instant; repeatable.

hands.name: Burning Hands
hands.text: Choose one adjacent visible target (single-target test version). Fire 3/3/5; Standard Burning 1, Strong Burning 2. Burning persists until removed. Repeatable. AoE is a separate test layer.

fan.name: Flame Fan
fan.text: Cast from your square. Choose a cardinal direction; affect a rectangle 3 squares wide and 2 squares deep immediately ahead, centered on that direction. Include every creature with an unobstructed attack path, including allies; caster outside area. Fire 3/3/5; Standard Burning 1, Strong Burning 2 until removed. Use worst applicable Boon/Bane situation for the shared player roll. Main, repeatable. Additional tactical-test card, excluded from single-target baseline.

heal.name: Mend
heal.text: One willing creature within 3, including self. Restore ceil(max HP/2)/full/full HP; Strong also ends Burning 1 level. Main, instant, repeatable. Does not restore the dead or end Last Words.

dressing.name: Field Dressing
dressing.text: One willing adjacent creature, including self; both hands free. Restore ceil(max HP/2)/full/full HP; Strong also reduces Bleeding by 1. Main, instant, repeatable. No spellcasting trigger. Cannot restore the dead or end Last Words. Provisional physical-healing alternative; not included in baseline simulations.

medium.name: Medium Armor Training
medium.text: May use medium armor: physical resistance 2 while worn. Grants one ordinary medium armor if absent at acquisition. No roll.

heavy.name: Heavy Armor Training
heavy.text: May use heavy armor: physical resistance 3 while worn. Grants one if absent. Does not require Medium Armor Training. No roll.

shield.name: Shield Training
shield.text: Grants one shield if absent. While carrying it, gain a Boon to Brawn defense rolls against forced movement; Shield Block itself is universal. No additional general defense Boon.

climb.name: Expert Climber
climb.text: Outside combat, one declared task involving climbing a surface; 10 minutes per attempt. Weak makes ordinary progress plus identifies a useful next approach; Standard achieves the declared task and identifies one related hazard; Strong also helps one companion perform the same task without rolling if still plausible. DA sets meaningful stakes; no unchanged retries. No discipline prerequisite.

swim.name: Strong Swimmer
swim.text: Outside combat, one declared task involving swimming through difficult water; 10 minutes per attempt. Weak makes ordinary progress plus identifies a useful next approach; Standard achieves the declared task and identifies one related hazard; Strong also helps one companion perform the same task without rolling if still plausible. DA sets meaningful stakes; no unchanged retries. No discipline prerequisite.

observe.name: Careful Observer
observe.text: Outside combat, one declared task involving searching a scene; 10 minutes per attempt. Weak makes ordinary progress plus identifies a useful next approach; Standard achieves the declared task and identifies one related hazard; Strong also helps one companion perform the same task without rolling if still plausible. DA sets meaningful stakes; no unchanged retries. No discipline prerequisite.

social.name: Read the Room
social.text: Outside combat, one declared task involving negotiating a plausible concession; 10 minutes per attempt. Weak makes ordinary progress plus identifies a useful next approach; Standard achieves the declared task and identifies one related hazard; Strong also helps one companion perform the same task without rolling if still plausible. DA sets meaningful stakes; no unchanged retries. No discipline prerequisite.

navigate.name: Wayfinder
navigate.text: Outside combat, one declared task involving finding a route; 10 minutes per attempt. Weak makes ordinary progress plus identifies a useful next approach; Standard achieves the declared task and identifies one related hazard; Strong also helps one companion perform the same task without rolling if still plausible. DA sets meaningful stakes; no unchanged retries. No discipline prerequisite.

animal.name: Animal Handler
animal.text: Outside combat, one declared task involving calming a nonhostile animal; 10 minutes per attempt. Weak makes ordinary progress plus identifies a useful next approach; Standard achieves the declared task and identifies one related hazard; Strong also helps one companion perform the same task without rolling if still plausible. DA sets meaningful stakes; no unchanged retries. No discipline prerequisite.

stealth.name: Quiet Passage
stealth.text: Outside combat, conceal movement over one short route in 1 minute. Weak progress plus identify an overlooked hiding place; Standard traverse unnoticed if plausible; Strong also guide one companion. No bypass of a fully watched open area.

locks.name: Patient Entry
locks.text: One reachable mundane lock with tools, 10 minutes. Cumulative progress 1/2/3 toward DA-declared target; Weak also identifies whether opening leaves evidence. Standard/Strong leave no evidence on completion. No automatic permission for magical locks.

forage.name: Forest Forage
forage.text: Outside combat, one hour in a viable forest. Choose mundane food or materials; raise its inventory die 1/2/3 steps, maximum d8 food or d6 materials. May create from out. DA determines availability and depletion before rolling; no spell components presumed.

craft.name: Field Craft
craft.text: Choose two ordinary recipes from arrows, torches, rations, rope when acquired. Requires recipe, tools, materials; outcomes and one-hour attempt time in crafting.md. No group work.

derive.name: Derive Ordinary Recipe
derive.text: Study one ordinary physical item with appropriate tools, 4 hours per attempt. Target 12 cumulative progress, gain 1/2/3. Retain progress if interrupted, require item again to resume. Does not destroy item. No magical derivation permission.

identify.name: Identify Magic
identify.text: Examine one item for 10 minutes. Weak learns whether magical and a hint of function; Standard learns function and activation requirements; Strong also identifies a curse if present. Does not provide recipe or waive requirements. New evidence needed for identical retry.

potions.name: Identify Potions
potions.text: Examine one bottle for 10 minutes. Weak learns broad purpose; Standard full ordinary function and use requirements; Strong also reveals contamination. Does not consume bottle. No recipe learned.

physical.name: Treat Physical Wound
physical.text: Treat one physical wound for one hour, once per wound per day, self or willing adjacent subject. Add 1/2/3 treatment progress. Wound target determines relief; scar remains.

mental.name: Treat Mental Wound
mental.text: Treat one mental wound for one hour, once per wound per day, self or willing nearby subject. Add 1/2/3 treatment progress. Wound target determines relief; scar remains.

grapple.name: Grapple
grapple.text: Adjacent target; add Grappled 1/2/3 to target and equal own contribution. Main, instant application, persists until released or reduced. Different grapplers add on target; release own contribution free. Player defense against NPC version: Brawn.

daze.name: Staggering Blow
daze.text: Adjacent target, melee weapon. Physical 3/4/6; Standard Dazed 1, Strong Dazed 2 until end of target next turn. Weak no Dazed. Repeatable; excluded baseline.

expose.name: Expose Enemies
expose.text: One visible enemy within 6. Weak next allied attack against it gains Boon before your next turn; Standard one ally adjacent to target makes free Basic Melee; Strong two distinct adjacent allies do so. Main; instant attacks, cannot trigger further free attacks.

summon.name: Summon Companion
summon.text: Main, no roll. Place companion in free visible square within 3: HP 6, Speed 5, resistance 0. Its Main adjacent attack uses controller Knowledge for physical 3/4/6; it may use universal Defend. Duration one combat or ten minutes. Summoning grants immediate Main command; no Reaction or summoning. See command rules.

adept_strike.name: Sweeping Strike
adept_strike.text: One visible target within 1. Physical 5/7/9; Strong may push 1 square. Instant; repeatable. Weapon/ammunition required if appropriate; ammunition check per attack.

master_strike.name: Decisive Strike
master_strike.text: One visible target within 1. Physical 6/8/11; Strong may push 1 square. Instant; repeatable. Weapon/ammunition required if appropriate; ammunition check per attack.

adept_fire.name: Flame Lance
adept_fire.text: One visible target within 6. Fire 5/7/9; Strong may push 1 square. Instant; repeatable. Weapon/ammunition required if appropriate; ammunition check per attack.

master_fire.name: Solar Lance
master_fire.text: One visible target within 6. Fire 6/8/11; Strong may push 1 square. Instant; repeatable. Weapon/ammunition required if appropriate; ammunition check per attack.

adept_shot.name: Piercing Shot
adept_shot.text: One visible target within 8. Physical 5/7/9; Strong may push 1 square. Instant; repeatable. Weapon/ammunition required if appropriate; ammunition check per attack.

master_shot.name: Perfect Shot
master_shot.text: One visible target within 8. Physical 6/8/11; Strong may push 1 square. Instant; repeatable. Weapon/ammunition required if appropriate; ammunition check per attack.

grit.name: World Hardened
grit.text: On purchase gain 1 Grit. Buy once ever; no discipline requirement.

hp.name: Toughened
hp.text: Maximum HP +1 permanently per purchase. At most once at each level 1–10; cannot bank missed purchases.

sig_protector_1_0.name: Hold the Line
sig_protector_1_0.text: Once per round after you take attack damage, move one adjacent willing ally 1 square without provoking.

sig_protector_1_1.name: Shelter
sig_protector_1_1.text: Your Defend also grants its Boon to one adjacent ally until your next turn; highest same bonus only.

sig_protector_1_2.name: Interpose
sig_protector_1_2.text: Reaction before an adjacent ally is attacked: become the target if you are a legal target. Resolve normally against you.

sig_protector_3_0.name: Guarded Advance
sig_protector_3_0.text: Move one willing ally within 2 squares up to 2 squares without provoking. Repeatable; instant.

sig_protector_3_1.name: Sheltering Line
sig_protector_3_1.text: Each adjacent ally gains a Boon to defense rolls until the start of your next turn. Repeatable; same named effect does not multiply.

sig_protector_3_2.name: Turn the Blow
sig_protector_3_2.text: Before an adjacent ally is attacked, become the target if legal. Resolve normally; afterward, if the attacker is adjacent, you may push it 1 square. Instant.

sig_protector_7_0.name: Wall of Iron
sig_protector_7_0.text: While your Defend is active, you have physical resistance 4. Use the highest matching resistance, not a sum.

sig_protector_7_1.name: Safe Passage
sig_protector_7_1.text: Each willing ally within 3 squares may immediately move up to their Speed without provoking. This grants movement only, not actions or commands. Repeatable.

sig_protector_7_2.name: Last Bastion
sig_protector_7_2.text: Before an adjacent ally suffers a physical attack, become its target if legal and use physical resistance 6 for that attack. Resolve your own defense normally. Instant.

sig_blade_1_0.name: Footwork
sig_blade_1_0.text: Once per turn after your melee attack, move 1 square without provoking.

sig_blade_1_1.name: Opening
sig_blade_1_1.text: Once per turn your Strong melee result may push its target 1 extra square.

sig_blade_1_2.name: Poise
sig_blade_1_2.text: Your Defend also protects against the next Bane caused solely by difficult footing before your next turn; cancel that Bane.

sig_blade_3_0.name: Fleeting Cut
sig_blade_3_0.text: Once per turn after your Main melee attack, move up to 2 squares without provoking.

sig_blade_3_1.name: Blade Opening
sig_blade_3_1.text: Once per round after a Strong Main melee attack, make a free Basic Melee attack against the same target if still adjacent. Free attacks cannot trigger this or further free attacks.

sig_blade_3_2.name: Disarming Line
sig_blade_3_2.text: One adjacent target, melee weapon. Physical 4/5/7; Standard also pushes 1 square; Strong pushes 1 and knocks prone. Instant; repeatable. Grants a missing ordinary melee weapon on acquisition.

sig_blade_7_0.name: Unerring Footwork
sig_blade_7_0.text: Once per turn after your Main melee attack, move up to 3 squares without provoking. Use this or another after-attack movement signature, not both.

sig_blade_7_1.name: Twin Opening
sig_blade_7_1.text: One adjacent target, melee weapon. Physical 6/8/11; Strong also grants one ally adjacent to that target a free Basic Melee attack. No free-attack chaining. Repeatable; grants a missing ordinary melee weapon on acquisition.

sig_blade_7_2.name: Whirlwind
sig_blade_7_2.text: Choose up to three adjacent targets; melee weapon. One worst-case roll, physical 4/6/8 to each. Unchosen creatures excluded. Instant; repeatable. Grants a missing ordinary melee weapon on acquisition.

sig_arcanist_1_0.name: Long Reach
sig_arcanist_1_0.text: Increase your single-target spell range by 1 square, excluding touch and area spells.

sig_arcanist_1_1.name: Sculpt Spark
sig_arcanist_1_1.text: Your fire spells may leave unattended objects unburned; once per turn after casting, move 1 square without provoking.

sig_arcanist_1_2.name: Arcane Insight
sig_arcanist_1_2.text: A Strong spell attack reveals one resistance type of the target, if any; DA chooses the type.

sig_arcanist_3_0.name: Reach of the Mind
sig_arcanist_3_0.text: Increase single-target spell range by 2 squares, excluding touch. Highest range increase applies; no increase to area size.

sig_arcanist_3_1.name: Chosen Flames
sig_arcanist_3_1.text: You may exclude one creature from your area spells before rolling. Determine worst-case modifiers after exclusion.

sig_arcanist_3_2.name: Focused Study
sig_arcanist_3_2.text: Study one visible creature within 6, once per creature per encounter. Weak reveals a hint about a resistance; Standard names one resistance type; Strong also reveals its value. If none, learn that instead.

sig_arcanist_7_0.name: Far-Reaching Mysteries
sig_arcanist_7_0.text: Increase single-target spell range by 3 squares, excluding touch. Highest range increase applies; no increase to area size.

sig_arcanist_7_1.name: Thread the Storm
sig_arcanist_7_1.text: You may exclude up to three creatures from your area spells before rolling. This replaces, rather than adds to, Chosen Flames.

sig_arcanist_7_2.name: Arcane Ward
sig_arcanist_7_2.text: Before your defense roll against a magical attack, gain two Boons to that roll. Instant; does not grant resistance.

sig_shepherd_1_0.name: Mercy
sig_shepherd_1_0.text: Your Strong healing outcome may instead end one level of Poisoned on the recipient as its benefit.

sig_shepherd_1_1.name: Guiding Voice
sig_shepherd_1_1.text: Your Aid can reach an ally who hears you within 3 squares instead of adjacent.

sig_shepherd_1_2.name: Shared Shelter
sig_shepherd_1_2.text: When you Defend, one willing adjacent ally may move 1 square without provoking, once per turn.

sig_shepherd_3_0.name: Cleanse
sig_shepherd_3_0.text: One willing target within 3, including self. Restore half maximum HP rounded up/full/full. Each outcome also reduces one of Burning, Freezing, Bleeding or Poisoned by 1; Strong reduces it by 2 instead. Instant; repeatable; magical healing. No restoration of dead or Last Words.

sig_shepherd_3_1.name: Guiding Choir
sig_shepherd_3_1.text: Your Aid can affect two distinct allies within 3 who hear you. Each receives its normal Boon to their next action roll within the normal Aid duration.

sig_shepherd_3_2.name: Steady Soul
sig_shepherd_3_2.text: You may use Reason instead of Fortitude for your death rolls. Choose before rolling; this grants no additional action while Dying.

sig_shepherd_7_0.name: Restoration
sig_shepherd_7_0.text: One willing target within 3, including self. Restore half maximum HP rounded up/full/full. Each outcome also ends one of Burning, Freezing, Bleeding or Poisoned; Strong ends a second of these conditions. Repeatable; magical healing; no restoration of dead, Last Words, or scars.

sig_shepherd_7_1.name: Chorus of Guidance
sig_shepherd_7_1.text: Your Aid can affect three distinct allies within 6 who hear you. Each receives the normal Aid benefit. Replaces Guiding Choir rather than adding targets.

sig_shepherd_7_2.name: Guardian Prayer
sig_shepherd_7_2.text: Before an ally within 3 makes a defense roll against a magical attack, grant two Boons to that roll. Instant.

sig_intellect_1_0.name: Preparation
sig_intellect_1_0.text: Once per scene after examining a mundane obstacle for one minute, learn its cumulative target before choosing whether to attempt it.

sig_intellect_1_1.name: Inference
sig_intellect_1_1.text: On a Strong observation result, ask one additional question about the observed evidence; DA answers truthfully within what it can reveal.

sig_intellect_1_2.name: Method
sig_intellect_1_2.text: Once per day on a derivation roll, gain a Boon; declare before rolling.

sig_intellect_3_0.name: Prepared Analysis
sig_intellect_3_0.text: Once per scene after studying a mundane obstacle for one minute, learn its cumulative target and one relevant hindrance before choosing whether to attempt it.

sig_intellect_3_1.name: Applied Theory
sig_intellect_3_1.text: On Strong derivation or permanent-item crafting, gain 1 additional progress. Does not change consumable inventory steps; does not grant crafting permission.

sig_intellect_3_2.name: Exploit the Pattern
sig_intellect_3_2.text: One visible creature within 6, once per creature per encounter. Weak reveals a behavioral clue; Standard names one weakness type; Strong also reveals its value. If none, learn that instead.

sig_intellect_7_0.name: Shared Preparation
sig_intellect_7_0.text: Before an outside-combat group check, spend ten minutes planning. Each participant gains one Boon to their contribution roll. Same plan does not stack or permit unchanged retries.

sig_intellect_7_1.name: Methodical Creation
sig_intellect_7_1.text: Your derivation and permanent-item crafting outcomes grant 2/3/4 progress. Replaces Applied Theory; does not grant permission, alter materials, or increase consumable inventory steps.

sig_intellect_7_2.name: Read Their Intent
sig_intellect_7_2.text: One visible creature within 6, once per creature per encounter. Weak reveals its current intended target if decided; Standard also reveals its intended action; Strong grants that target a Boon to its next defense before end of your next turn. New events may change the creature intention; the Boon remains.

sig_leader_1_0.name: Rally
sig_leader_1_0.text: Your Aid can reach one ally within 3 who hears you.

sig_leader_1_1.name: Advance
sig_leader_1_1.text: When you Defend, one ally within 3 who hears you may move 1 square without provoking, once per turn.

sig_leader_1_2.name: Resolve
sig_leader_1_2.text: Once per round when an adjacent ally enters Dying, you may move 1 square toward them without provoking; no additional action granted.

sig_leader_3_0.name: Coordinated Advance
sig_leader_3_0.text: One willing ally within 3 who hears you moves up to 2 squares without provoking. Instant; repeatable.

sig_leader_3_1.name: Expose an Opening
sig_leader_3_1.text: One visible enemy within 8. Weak grants a Boon to the next allied attack against it before your next turn; Standard grants one adjacent ally a free Basic Melee against it; Strong grants two distinct adjacent allies that attack. No free-attack chains.

sig_leader_3_2.name: Inspiring Stand
sig_leader_3_2.text: When you Defend, one ally within 3 who hears you gains a Boon to its next defense before your next turn. Once per turn.

sig_leader_7_0.name: Grand Advance
sig_leader_7_0.text: Two distinct willing allies within 6 who hear you may each move up to 3 squares without provoking. Instant; repeatable.

sig_leader_7_1.name: Coordinated Assault
sig_leader_7_1.text: One visible enemy within 6. Grant 1/2/3 distinct allies adjacent to it a free Basic Melee attack against it. No free-attack chaining. Instant; repeatable.

sig_leader_7_2.name: Counteroffensive
sig_leader_7_2.text: After an ally within 3 takes attack damage, that ally may make a free Basic Melee against its attacker if adjacent and able. Cannot trigger from a free attack; no further free-attack chains.

sig_unbalanced_1_0.name: Momentum
sig_unbalanced_1_0.text: Once per turn your Strong melee result may push its target 1 extra square.

sig_unbalanced_1_1.name: Break Through
sig_unbalanced_1_1.text: On Strong Force against an object, gain one additional progress; no effect on creatures.

sig_unbalanced_1_2.name: Relentless
sig_unbalanced_1_2.text: Once per turn after dealing melee damage, move 1 square toward a visible enemy without provoking.

sig_unbalanced_3_0.name: Crushing Momentum
sig_unbalanced_3_0.text: Once per turn, your Strong Main melee attack may push its target 2 additional squares. Replaces Momentum rather than adding to it.

sig_unbalanced_3_1.name: Break the Barrier
sig_unbalanced_3_1.text: Force against an object grants 1/2/4 progress. Force against creatures remains unchanged. Replaces Break Through.

sig_unbalanced_3_2.name: Furious Charge
sig_unbalanced_3_2.text: Move up to your Speed toward a visible enemy, then attack one adjacent target with a melee weapon for physical 4/5/7. Movement provokes normally; no attack if no legal target reached. Repeatable; grants a missing melee weapon on acquisition.

sig_unbalanced_7_0.name: Avalanche
sig_unbalanced_7_0.text: Once per turn, your Strong Main melee attack may push its target 3 additional squares. Replaces Momentum and Crushing Momentum.

sig_unbalanced_7_1.name: Shatter
sig_unbalanced_7_1.text: Force against an object grants 2/3/5 progress. Force against creatures remains unchanged. Replaces other Force-against-object signature improvements.

sig_unbalanced_7_2.name: Unstoppable Charge
sig_unbalanced_7_2.text: Move up to your Speed toward a visible enemy, then attack one adjacent target with a melee weapon for physical 6/8/11. Strong also knocks prone. Movement provokes normally; no attack if no legal target reached. Repeatable; grants a missing melee weapon on acquisition.

sig_shadow_1_0.name: Slip Away
sig_shadow_1_0.text: Once per turn after Disengage, move 1 square without provoking.

sig_shadow_1_1.name: Silent Entry
sig_shadow_1_1.text: With lock tools, attempt one reachable mundane lock outside combat for five minutes. Roll Guile for 1/2/3 cumulative progress toward the DA-declared target. Grants missing lock tools on acquisition; no other card required.

sig_shadow_1_2.name: False Trail
sig_shadow_1_2.text: On a Strong concealed-movement roll, also obscure evidence of the route for mundane trackers until new evidence appears.

sig_shadow_3_0.name: Slipping Shadow
sig_shadow_3_0.text: Once per turn after Disengage, move up to 2 squares without provoking. Replaces Slip Away.

sig_shadow_3_1.name: Swift Entry
sig_shadow_3_1.text: With lock tools, attempt one reachable mundane lock outside combat for one minute. Gain 1/2/3 cumulative progress toward the DA-declared target. Grants missing lock tools on acquisition; no other card required.

sig_shadow_3_2.name: Guided Passage
sig_shadow_3_2.text: On a Strong concealed-movement roll, guide one additional companion along the route without a roll if still plausible. No effect on fully watched open ground.

sig_shadow_7_0.name: Vanish
sig_shadow_7_0.text: Move up to Speed without provoking. If you end out of sight and concealed, become Hidden. You cannot become Hidden in a visible open square. Repeatable.

sig_shadow_7_1.name: Ghost Keys
sig_shadow_7_1.text: Use lock tools on one adjacent mundane lock, including in combat. Gain 1/2/3 cumulative progress toward the DA-declared target. Repeatable; grants missing lock tools on acquisition; no other card required.

sig_shadow_7_2.name: No Trace
sig_shadow_7_2.text: Your concealed movement leaves no mundane tracks, whatever the outcome. Weak still only makes progress; it does not guarantee reaching the destination or escaping notice.

sig_odd_1_0.name: Unexpected Route
sig_odd_1_0.text: Once per scene, use Guile instead of an attribute on an ordinary noncombat task; declare before rolling, not on a purchased card.

sig_odd_1_1.name: Unusual Friend
sig_odd_1_1.text: Your Aid can reach one ally within 3 who sees or hears you.

sig_odd_1_2.name: Odd Footwork
sig_odd_1_2.text: Once per turn after Force, move 1 square without provoking.

sig_odd_3_0.name: Unexpected Talent
sig_odd_3_0.text: Once per scene, use any one of your attributes for an ordinary outside-combat task. Declare before rolling; does not change a purchased card or grant specialist permission.

sig_odd_3_1.name: Unusual Company
sig_odd_3_1.text: Your Aid reaches one ally within 6 who sees or hears you. Highest Aid range applies.

sig_odd_3_2.name: Strange Footwork
sig_odd_3_2.text: Once per turn after Force, move up to 2 squares without provoking. Replaces Odd Footwork.

sig_odd_7_0.name: Impossible Talent
sig_odd_7_0.text: Once per scene, substitute any one of your attributes on one action, defense, or death roll. Declare before rolling. Does not grant permission or extra actions; no effect on inventory or wound dice.

sig_odd_7_1.name: Unexpected Alliance
sig_odd_7_1.text: Your Aid can affect two distinct allies within 6 who see or hear you. Each receives the normal Aid benefit; replaces smaller Aid target limits.

sig_odd_7_2.name: Elsewhere
sig_odd_7_2.text: Once per turn after Force, move up to 3 squares without provoking. Replaces other Odd after-Force movement signatures.
